The "We're excited about you because…" section is treated as requirements, so its items default to required. The "Nice to Have" heading makes every item under it nice_to_have.
Technologies that appear only in the responsibilities (tracing, metrics, benchmarking, Kubernetes autoscaling) are not labeled from there. Kubernetes is labeled from the Nice to Have section instead.
"a backend or systems programming language" asks for a language. backend-development is not labeled because "backend" only qualifies the language here.
"ML inference infrastructure" is mapped to model-serving and marked uncertain. ai-infrastructure is the alternative mapping.
"inference runtimes" and "CPU/GPU performance profiling" are not mapped to inference-optimization because that would be too loose a fit. Both are left in unmapped.
"tested implementation" is not labeled as testing because it describes delivery, not a named skill.
Seniority: "2+ years" sits at the 0–2 year boundary, so I inferred junior and marked it uncertain. The title names no level.
Degree: no level is named, so it defaults to bachelor. "or have equivalent practical experience" sets degree_or_equivalent to true.
